report:
Independently reviewed the complete body.elaboration claim, all three associated implementation files, and all three test entries. Captured the checking design, architectural-foundations RFD, Typed IR representation, and the in-memory test setup/lookup helpers. This review is source inspection; behavioral suites were centrally run and were not rerun here. No Rust files were authored or changed in this review.

The normative requirement is a successful completed semantic tree with final types and identities and explicit type-directed operations, without source method syntax, unresolved names, inference variables, pending obligations or adjustment recipes. The RFD confirms this is a successful-output requirement and permits structured control flow above MIR. expr.rs checks source forms into typed nodes: its method branch consumes a resolved target and signature, materializes receiver adjustment and argument coercion, submits the parameter environment where needed and emits ResolvedCall; failures produce diagnosed error types. Field and path checking similarly operate through resolution rather than preserving an unchecked source lookup. This is implementation progress, not an assertion that every language operation has complete coverage.

infer_ctx.rs finish guards completion against pending obligations, non-root live inference branches, active tasks, unpublished wakes and unfilled expression slots. It transfers only the finalized body and diagnostics into CheckedBody. finalize.rs follows root egraph representatives recursively when copying types, rejects escaped InferVar, resolves expression slots and copies expression/type graphs into a fresh target stash. It also copies call targets and their type arguments. These mechanisms establish the intended boundary; the completed representation still contains source-shaped variants, and the finalizer is not itself a blanket validator rejecting every possible such variant. The associated TODO explicitly retains the full completion-rejection matrix, so this report does not upgrade those incomplete checks into full implementation proof.

The ordinary body_finalization_resolves_types_into_a_fresh_stash test unifies an inference variable with i32, places it inside a tuple expression type, finalizes, asserts the original source still contains InferVar(0), and asserts the completed tuple element is i32. It meaningfully verifies recursive resolved output without mutating the source, but uses a Missing expression and does not demonstrate method/operator/coercion lowering or all forbidden-form rejection.

The second ordinary test indexing_reports_unsupported_until_call_elaboration_exists runs the actual body query for x[0usize] on &[i32] and requires the exact diagnostic indexing elaboration is not supported yet. The captured harness creates a database, parses the supplied root source, and selects the named local function, so the assertion reaches real checking rather than a mock. expr.rs matches that contract: it checks both operands, records this error and assigns Ty::Error while retaining an Index recovery node. This prevents unmaterialized Index/IndexMut behavior from masquerading as successful elaboration; it is not evidence that indexing calls have been implemented.

The checking_body_elaboration TODO explicitly defers the complete verification matrix: structural Typed-IR snapshots for paths, fields, calls, generic substitutions, borrows, dereferences, coercions and recovery; rejection checks for all unresolved/live internal forms; and exact independent rustc oracle comparisons for selected slices. Its prerequisite is completing and associating those claim-specific checks and the corresponding supported lowering. I preserve this deferral for the full successful-output requirement, including semantic identity and materialization of all type-directed operations. The two ordinary tests prove their narrow finalization and diagnosed-indexing scenarios only. No claim weakening, fabricated execution result, or blanket assertion of full elaboration completeness is made. All current evidence entries are accounted for and no additional concrete edits are requested.
